Prerequisite: Astrologian 11, Diurnal Sect

At 11th level, while under the Diurnal Sect, the astrologian no longer needs to eat to survive and she gains +2 bonus on saves against disease. In addition, at 14th level, she becomes immune to non-magical diseases and no longer need to drink water to survive. At 17th level, she becomes immune to magical diseases, gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against poisons, and only needs to sleep half as long to rest or recover from fatigue or exhaustion. At 20th level, she becomes immune to poison and fatigue. This ability only functions while the sun in shining.
